name: Izumi Hiro
source:
A teacher at Marenis High School who serves as the advisor for the Occult Research Club.
Possesses a wealth of knowledge regarding the occult.
Has a friendly and approachable personality, with deep trust from the students.

"Unlike you guys, I'm an old guy."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=10]official website[/url]]
